# cloudsmith_license_policy (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) The description of the license policy.
- `name` (String) The name of the license policy.
- `organization` (String) Organization to which this policy belongs.
- `spdx_identifiers` (Set of String) The licenses to deny.

### Optional

- `allow_unknown_licenses` (Boolean) Allow unknown licenses within the policy.
- `on_violation_quarantine` (Boolean) On violation of the license policy, quarantine violating packages.
- `package_query_string` (String) A search / filter string of packages to include in the policy.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the policy was created at.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug_perm` (String) Slug-perm of the license policy
- `updated_at` (String) The time the policy last updated at.
